P_0x0031A7.en: A pilot of the ATX Team's Steel Dragon Squadron, nicknamed Billy. A serious young man with a strong sense of duty and honor. Has a strong sense of justice and hates anything underhanded. Often gets dragged along by the reckless Kyosuke and Excellen. Possesses the special psychic ability of "telekinesis" and pilots a unit equipped with the T-LINK System. Rank: Ensign.

P_0x00372C.en: SRX Team pilot and squad leader. A telekinetic; before enlisting she was a test subject in her father's research. Later joined the <SRX Project> and helped develop the <T-LINK System>.\nResponsible and caring. Seems headstrong, but is truly kind and dislikes fighting. Rank: Captain.

P_0x0056C5.en: A pilot of the <Earth Fed Army> <Aggressors>. Upbeat and breezy, but serious at heart. A <School> graduate who joined the <DC> remnants after the <L5 Campaign> and fought Kyosuke, until meeting Latooni led her to join them.

P_0x0059ED.en: A pilot of the <Earth Fed Army> <Aggressors>. A <School> graduate, skilled in <Personal Trooper> combat. Harsh training there closed her heart, but meeting Ryuusei and the others helped her regain her humanity.

P_0x005D86.en: Chief of <Project TD>'s system dev team, keeping it running with backing from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>. Caring and personable, though capable of cold, rational judgment.

P_0x00653B.en: A soldier in <Earth Fed Army> Intelligence. Calm and sharp, somewhat mysterious, yet loyal at heart. Graduate of the <Aggressors>, who built the <TC-OS> base data; top-tier <Personal Trooper> pilot. Rank: Major.

P_0x0066BD.en: Advisor to the <Tesla Leicht Institute>. A Jigen-ryu sword master who helped develop the Grungust's blade and sword data. Teacher to Sanger and Brit. Strict on swordplay, easygoing else.

P_0x008924.en: The test pilot of Medius Locus, a TE Absorber developed by the Zentle Project. Former captain of "Craywolves," the 3rd Special Operations <PT> Unit of the <Earth Fed Army>. A strict soldier with a strong sense of responsibility.
